title: BMAD repo structure and spec-first pattern
summary: BMAD enforces a spec → plan → implement → test loop. The repo includes agent persona definitions, task templates, and checklists that constrain execution order.

claims.claim: BMAD uses persona-based agent definitions with explicit task checklists
claims.evidence: Repo contains /agents/ folder with .md persona files and /checklists/ with step-by-step validation gates

claims.claim: Spec-first workflow requires approved specification before implementation begins
claims.evidence: Task flow enforces: create-spec → review-spec → approve-spec → implement, with gate checks at each transition
